tools.name: intellihr_get_person
tools.description: One person's full record by id: names, date of birth, gender, employee number, contact details, addresses, emergency contact, employment status, jobs, work rights, user account and custom fields. Health information is never returned. GET /people/{id}.

tools.name: intellihr_list_person_documents
tools.description: The documents stored on a person's record (file name, type, size, upload status and a download link). Contents are not read. GET /people/{personId}/documents.

tools.name: intellihr_list_person_skills
tools.description: The skills assigned to a person (with their level and review details as intelliHR returns them). The whole list comes back at once. GET /people/{personId}/skills.

tools.name: intellihr_list_person_tasks
tools.description: Tasks (forms, reviews, check-ins, onboarding steps) for a person, by tab: DUE (default), ABOUT_ME, ABOUT_OTHERS, DONE or IGNORED. GET /people/{personId}/tasks.

tools.name: intellihr_list_jobs
tools.description: List jobs (roles people hold, past, current and future) as at today: person, position title, location, business unit and entity, supervisor, work type, FTE, remuneration schedule, start/end dates and status. Filter by person, job title, status (Current Job, Future Job, Ending Job, Past Job), work ty

tools.name: intellihr_get_job
tools.description: One job by id with its person, position title, location, business unit, supervisor, pay grade, remuneration and dates. GET /jobs/{id}.

tools.name: intellihr_get_job_timeline
tools.description: The upcoming changes and current information about a job (scheduled changes, end date). GET /jobs/{jobId}/timeline.

tools.name: intellihr_list_locations
tools.description: The organisation's locations (sites) with parent location, code, address, enabled flag and representatives. GET /locations.

tools.name: intellihr_list_business_units
tools.description: The organisation's business units (departments, teams). Filter by name or identifier. GET /business-units.

tools.name: intellihr_list_business_entities
tools.description: The organisation's business entities (legal employers). GET /business-entities.

tools.name: intellihr_list_position_titles
tools.description: The position titles (job names) defined in intelliHR. Filter by name. GET /position-titles.

tools.name: intellihr_list_pay_grades
tools.description: The pay grades and their rates, optionally as at a date. GET /pay-grades.

tools.name: intellihr_list_users
tools.description: The user accounts that can sign in to intelliHR: username, enabled flag, permission groups and the linked person. GET /users.

tools.name: intellihr_list_custom_field_definitions
tools.description: The custom fields defined in intelliHR (what each field on a person, job or location means and its type). GET /custom-field-definitions.

tools.name: intellihr_list_reference_data
tools.description: Look up one of intelliHR's reference lists: employment_conditions, work_classes, work_types, work_rights, recruitment_sources, extended_leave_types, job_change_reasons, skill_disciplines, training_types, training_providers, qualification_types, qualification_library_items, onboarding_templates, perm

tools.name: intellihr_list_skills
tools.description: The skills catalogue, optionally only business-critical skills or one discipline. GET /skills.

tools.name: intellihr_list_qualifications
tools.description: Qualification records held by people (licences, certificates) with status and dates. Filter by person, employee number or library item. GET /qualifications.

tools.name: intellihr_list_trainings
tools.description: Training records completed or booked by people, with provider, type and dates. Filter by training name, provider, type, employee number or email. GET /trainings.

tools.name: intellihr_create_person
tools.description: WRITE: create a new person record in intelliHR (last name required). It creates the person only: no job, no user account and no welcome email is sent. A job is added separately in intelliHR. Check with list_people first to avoid duplicates. POST /people.

tools.name: intellihr_update_person
tools.description: WRITE: change fields on an existing person (only the fields you pass change): names, date of birth, gender, employee number, title and emergency contact. Contact details, addresses and jobs are not changed by this tool. PATCH /people/{id}.

tools.name: intellihr_create_extended_leave
tools.description: WRITE: record extended leave (parental, long service, unpaid, etc.) on an existing job. It changes the person's employment record and can trigger intelliHR workflows. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: intellihr_list_people, intellihr_list_person_skills, intellihr_list_person_tasks, intellihr_list_trainings, intellihr_create_person · Private data: intellihr_list_people, intellihr_get_person, intellihr_list_person_documents, intellihr_list_qualifications, intellihr_list_trainings, intellihr_create_person, intellihr_update_person, intellihr_create_extended_leave · Public sink: intellihr_list_people, intellihr_list_person_documents, intellihr_list_trainings, intellihr_create_person, intellihr_create_extended_leave.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: intellihr_list_people, intellihr_list_person_skills, intellihr_list_person_tasks, intellihr_list_trainings, intellihr_create_person · Private data: intellihr_list_people, intellihr_get_person, intellihr_list_person_documents, intellihr_list_qualifications, intellihr_list_trainings, intellihr_create_person, intellihr_update_person, intellihr_create_extended_leave · Public sink: intellihr_list_people, intellihr_list_person_documents, intellihr_list_trainings, intellihr_create_person, intellihr_create_extended_leave

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
